security.mfa: Required for all withdrawals and transfers.
security.biometrics: Supported on iOS and Android (Settings -> Security).

account_management.password_policy: 8-128 characters, must include Uppercase, Lowercase, Number, and Special Character.

payment_failed: Ensure 3D Secure is enabled on your card.
Check if recipient phone number starts with +250.
kyc_rejected: National ID must be valid (not expired).
troubleshooting.rate_expired: Refresh the page/screen to fetch the new live rate.

security_policies.data_protection: AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data. GDPR and Rwandan Data Protection Law compliant.
security_policies.fraud_prevention: Real-time transaction monitoring and automated account suspension for suspicious activity.
security_policies.escalation: For lost cards or hacked accounts, call +250 700 000 000 immediately.

business_rules.refund_policy: Completed transfers cannot be reversed once paid to the recipient. Contact support for disputes.
business_rules.support_hours: Online chat: 24/7. Phone support: 8 AM - 6 PM CAT.
